title: RNA Extraction from Cells
author: Yujie Fan
materials: Once the cell lysis has been collected in 1.5mL Eppendorf tubes, the rest of the RNA extraction is preformed using the Direct-zol RNA Miniprep kit (Cat No. R2051) and protocol provided by Zymo Research.
Aspirate the DPBS and add 350ul Trizol (Cat No.R2051, Zymo Research) onto the cells directly. Increase the volume of trizol if you have a well plate larger than a 24 well plate.

steps.title: Prepare Cells
steps.instruction: Remove the 24-well plate from the incubator, aspirate the cell media, and wash the cells gently once with DPBS.

steps.title: Collect Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: Use a P1000 pipette to pipette up and down to collect all cell lysis, ensuring all corners are reached until the bottom is clear.

substeps.instruction: Optional: Freeze cell lysis in 1.5mL Eppendorf tubes at -80°C for up to 3 days.

steps.title: Bind RNA to Column
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume (350uL) of 100% ethanol to each sample using a P1000 pipette.

substeps.instruction: Pipette up and down multiple times to thoroughly mix ethanol and trizol.
Transfer the entire mixture into a Zymo-Spin IICR column.
Centrifuge columns at x10,000g for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: First RNA Wash
steps.instruction: Transfer columns into a new collection tube and discard the flow-through.

substeps.instruction: Add 400uL of RNA Wash Buffer (with ethanol already added) to each column.
Centrifuge at x10,000g for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Perform DNA Digestion
steps.instruction: Prepare a DNase 1 mixture and apply it to the columns.

substeps.instruction: In a separate 1.5mL Eppendorf tube, mix 5uL of DNase 1 with 75uL of DNA digestion buffer per sample.
Mix by gentle inversion or pipetting.
Add 80uL of this mixture to each sample column.
Incubate for 15-20 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: RNA Pre-Wash
steps.instruction: Add 400uL RNA Pre-Wash Buffer to each sample and centrifuge at x10,000g for 1 minute at room temperature.

steps.title: Final RNA Wash
steps.instruction: Add 700uL of RNA Wash buffer to each column and centrifuge at x10,000g for 1 minute at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge again to ensure complete removal of ethanol and washing buffer.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer columns to pre-labeled RNAse-free Eppendorf tubes and elute the RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 50uL of DNAse/RNAse-free water to each column.
Centrifuge at x10,000g for one minute.

steps.title: Quantify and Store RNA
steps.instruction: Discard flow-through and measure RNA concentrations using a NanoDrop.
